intro_body: We continuously poll company career pages directly - the same ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workable, SmartRecruiters, BambooHR, Breezy, Personio, Recruitee, Teamtailor) a company posts to before a role ever reaches LinkedIn or a public job board. Every new posting found this way is automatically scored against your resume, and your resume and application questions can be pre-filled without you lifting a finger. Passing jobs show up ready-to-apply on your Dashboard, usually while the listing is still fresh.
step1_hint: Background crawler that finds new postings. It rediscovers the full list of known companies on each supported ATS on the interval below, and checks each known company for new postings on its own adaptive schedule (as often as every 15 minutes for very active companies, tapering down to once a day for quiet ones).
backlog_hours_tooltip: When you press Run, postings already found but not yet evaluated that are no older than this are evaluated right away, in parallel with the live listening.
step2_hint: Get a Telegram message whenever a newly discovered job finishes being scored.
telegram_missing_key_toast: Add a Telegram bot token and chat ID before enabling notifications.
min_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or above this are marked "passed" and move on to the next steps.
max_score_tooltip: Jobs scoring at or below this are considered a clear miss.
auto_archive_tooltip: Otherwise they're just flagged, not hidden.
step4_hint: Runs automatically for a level below only if at least one change type in it is checked to auto-apply.
change_type_title_tooltip: Changes the main headline under your name (e.g. your title/specialization).
change_type_company_name_tooltip: Only reworks how a role's job title is phrased under an experience entry - not the company name, not the main headline.
change_type_skills_tooltip: Reorders and rephrases the skills list, using only skills already present in your resume.
change_type_summary_tooltip: Rewrites the summary paragraph to foreground experience relevant to this posting.
change_type_bullet_tooltip: Targeted edits to experience bullets/paragraphs, weaving in the posting's keywords without inventing anything.
step5_tooltip: Every passing job automatically gets an application with these questions pre-answered, attached to it.
step5_hint: Runs automatically whenever this list isn't empty.
base_question_placeholder: e.g. Describe a project you're proud of
